<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_ck0002056516_AllocationOfFundIncomeLossesAndDistributionsTextBlock', window );">Allocation of Fund Income, Losses, and Distributions</a></td>
<td class="text"><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="display:flex;margin-top:6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(7)</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Allocation of Fund Income, Losses, and Distributions</span></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:4%;display:flex;margin-top:6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.166666666666667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Allocations</span></div></div><p style="margin-left:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Net investment income or loss, net realized gain or loss, and unrealized gain or loss on investments are allocated in accordance with the Fund&#8217;s private placement memorandum.</span></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:4%;display:flex;margin-top:6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.166666666666667%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Distributions</span></div></div><p style="margin-left:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Board will determine the timing and amount, if any, of the Fund&#8217;s distributions. The Fund intends to pay distributions on a quarterly basis. In order to avoid corporate-level tax on the distributed income as a RIC, the Fund must distribute to Shareholders at least 90.0% of ordinary income and realized net short-term capital gains in excess of realized net long-term capital losses, if any, on an annual basis out of the assets legally available for such distributions. </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In order for the Fund to avoid certain excise taxes imposed on RICs, the Fund currently intends to distribute, or be deemed to distribute, during each calendar year an amount at least equal to the sum of (1) 98.0% of the Fund&#8217;s ordinary income for the calendar year, (2) 98.2% of the Fund&#8217;s capital gain in excess of capital loss for the one-year period ending on such calendar year and (3) any ordinary income and net capital gain for preceding years that were not distributed during such years and on which we paid no U.S. federal income tax.</span></span></p><p style="margin-left:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Fund has adopted an &#8220;opt out&#8221; distribution reinvestment plan (&#8220;DRIP&#8221;) for Shareholders. When a distribution is declared, Shareholders&#8217; cash distributions will automatically (net of any applicable withholding tax) be reinvested in additional shares unless a Shareholder specifically &#8220;opts out&#8221; of the Fund&#8217;s DRIP. Shareholders may opt out of the Fund&#8217;s DRIP by providing notice ten (10) business days in advance of the distribution record date.</span></p><p style="margin-left:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the six months ended June 30, 2026 and the period from February 4, 2025 (commencement of operations) to June 30, 2025, the following table summarizes the distribution declared on Class I shares and that remains payable as of June 30, 2026</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and summarizes the settlement of distributions declared, respectively, and the subsequent cash payment or reinvestment of those distributions. The Private Fund's final distribution was recorded on May 31, 2026, and consisted of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">2,182,678</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> to the Limited Partners and $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">246,155</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> to the General Partner.</span></p><div><p style="margin-left:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The following table summarizes the Fund&#8217;s dividends during the </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Six Months Ended June 30, 2026:</span></p><p style="margin-left:8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p>
